rationale: The /fly visualization calls transferEllipse (via buildArcs at fly/+page.svelte:206) for all non-Moon missions. transferEllipse hardcodes a = (r1 + r2) / 2 — a Hohmann-only semi-major axis — regardless of the actual angular separation between Earth and destination, and explicitly discards the mission's real arrival V∞ (the _arrivalVInfKms parameter is marked as unused at fly/+page.svelte:187–190). outboundArc is the decoy: same file, similar signature, includes V∞ shaping, and sweeps a fixed 180° half-ellipse, but it is NOT consumed by /fly — only by test/validation harnesses and the thumbnail script.
